unclaimed_bribes_present.meaning: unclaimed bribes for the source tokenId exist in the Bribe contracts before merging

voted_from_false.meaning: !voted[_from] holds after the user calls reset(), i.e. the source token has no recorded vote before merging

claim_succeeds.meaning: GaugeManager.claimBribes() succeeds for the source tokenId (does not fail the _isApprovedOrOwner access control check)

claims.scope: VotingEscrow.merge() of veNFTs and subsequent bribe claiming

preconditions.text: Unclaimed bribes for the source tokenId exist in the Bribe contracts before merging.; The user calls reset() so that !voted[_from] holds before merging, removing voting weight while unclaimed bribes remain.
preconditions.derivation: Program conjunction of selected report preconditions.

safety.text: Merging veNFTs should not destroy the source token's claimable bribes; accumulated bribes must remain claimable or be migrated.
safety.derivation: Program synthesis from the selected intent and logical pattern.

effects.text: GaugeManager.claimBribes() fails for burned tokens due to the _isApprovedOrOwner access control check.
effects.derivation: Program-generated direct negation witness for the selected safety pattern.

effect_coverage.reason: Program-generated exact coverage for selected direct impact.

assumptions: The merge caller is the owner or approved operator of the source veNFT; the report does not distinguish these cases.
The source tokenId had bribes accrued in the Bribe contracts prior to the merge, as asserted by the report.

limitations: Only the claim_fails_burned_token impact is formalized; owner_zero_after_burn and bribes_lost are deferred and not implied by this claim.
The claim_succeeds observable is a report-grounded Boolean because the report states the access-control failure qualitatively without numeric operands.
The condition encodes the report's stated scenario (unclaimed bribes present and !voted[_from] after reset) rather than a general merge requirement.
Runtime binding of claimBribes() and _isApprovedOrOwner is deferred to later stages.
